full_text:
BOARD OF PHARMACY
DEPARTMENT OF CONSUMER AFFAIRS
STATE OF CALIFORNIA

COMPLAINT ACKNOWLEDGEMENT

Case Number: CI 2025 112397
Subject: Walmart Pharmacy #1660

The Board of Pharmacy has received your complaint regarding the above-referenced pharmacy. Your case has been assigned to an enforcement analyst for review. Please retain Case Number CI 2025 112397 for all future correspondence...
